preconditions.description: The number of months n must be between 2 and 500,000.
The length of the list a must be equal to the ceiling of n divided by 2.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= ai <= 10**9 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the list a must be within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.
The income x for the remaining months must be within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output must be either the integer k or -1 if no valid k exists.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(a[i:i+k]) > 0 for i in range(n - k + 1))
postconditions.description: For each k consecutive months, the total income must be positive.
The value of k must be a positive integer less than or equal to n.
